work_unit.title: 完成 Target Workbench 和 Home 操作闭环
work_unit.goal: 让操作员在 Web Chat、Target Workbench 和 Home 看见权威投影并完成其有权限的创建、运行、重试、取消、评审、验收、动作批准、执行和恢复操作；候选提交与外部动作请求保持 Agent/Service 权限边界。

authority_rules: UI renders server-projected command state and never invents completion optimistically.
Candidate-only Submission and ActionRequest remain Agent/Service operations; the board may inspect their state but cannot impersonate a candidate.
Review, action approval and Acceptance are separate human commands with immutable Submission, review, parameter-hash and revision bindings visible before execution.
Every mutation exposes pending, success, rejection/error and retry behavior, then refetches authoritative facts.
All copy has English and Simplified Chinese parity and every visual status has text or an icon in addition to color.

tdd_plan.red: Add component/API tests for authority-aware command availability, immutable bindings, pending isolation, success refetch, server rejection detail and retry.
tdd_plan.green: Wire the existing native Target, adjudication and connector routes into a compact operational command surface and actionable Attention/Home links.
tdd_plan.refactor: Centralize command feedback and binding presentation while preserving flat workbench sections and existing design tokens.

commands: focused Target Workbench, Home, Dialog and Attention tests
desktop Playwright screenshots and console/network inspection

required_items: review, approval and acceptance binding proof
pending, error, rejection and retry component proof

stop_conditions: The UI marks a command complete before the authoritative refetch returns.
The board fabricates an Agent or Service identity to create a Submission or ActionRequest.
Review, approval or Acceptance can be issued without showing the immutable object/hash it binds.
An actionable failure is hidden, translated into success or has no retry path.
